name: repo-harness-tuner
description: Run evidence-backed Codex harness doctor/loop workflows and generate project team/skill plans.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Codex team/skill plans and improve repo harnesses.
interface.longDescription: Repo Harness Tuner combines a team/skill factory with an adaptive harness engine. The one-command doctor and run-loop inspect, diagnose, design, factory-plan, tune, evaluate, and history-track a repo from a single CLI entry point before any writes happen. The v0.8 closed loop persists scored eval results in Docs/AI/harness-eval-results.jsonl and feeds eval/history signals back into diagnose, tune, factory, and run-loop next-action selection. Factory output stays grounded in concrete repo evidence such as project markers, package scripts, harness files, source markers, validation commands, stale artifacts, conflicts, installed skill overlaps, and closed-loop feedback. The fixture suite covers empty, Vite/Node, Unity, Codex plugin, already-harnessed, history-pressure, and eval-score-pressure project shapes so later changes have regression coverage. The factory side designs project-specific Codex agent roles, planned skills, orchestration docs, visible/background worker policies, repo-local team/skill artifacts, copyable Codex SKILL.md drafts, confirmed skill installs, and Codex plugin team presets. The engine side runs analyze, diagnose, design, tune, restructure, evaluate, and feedback loops for repo-local Codex harness design. It includes codex-harness-setup so one plugin can bootstrap, generate reviewable diffs, tune, review, evaluate, score and persist evaluation results, track history feedback, and manage AGENTS.md, Docs/AI/*, validation guidance, human-involvement policy, Codex worker patterns, target files, and next review triggers as the project evolves.
capabilities: Codex team and skill factory planning
Repo-local agent and skill artifact generation
Closed-loop diagnosis from eval and history
